This repository accompanies the paper D2K-Bench: Can LLM Agents Turn Expert Designs into Efficient GPU Kernels? . Directory contents dataset/ — one directory per task: the naive reference, the per-task evaluator config and grader inputs, the model-visible task spec and starter, and the design rubric, schema, and expert design guidance. tasks/ — packed Parquet task tables ( frontier_sol_triton.parquet , frontier_sol_cuda.parquet , frontier_sol_cutlass.parquet ), 26 rows each. example_workspace/ — prebuilt agent workspaces per task (baseline, design guidance, and the cumulative L1 and L1+L2 ablations). docker/ — the Dockerfile and build script for the runtime image (shared base, per-task environments, and the sandbox server). script/ — packing, workspace build, batch launch, timing, grading, sandbox server/client, API proxies, and offline validation. capability/ — design authoring and design/code scoring ( scorer/ ) with the prompt templates they load ( prompt/ ). requirements-control.txt — Python dependencies for the control host. Design contract Each task carries expert design guidance split into three cumulative levels: L1 — High-level algorithmic insights ( level_1_high_level_algorithmic_insights ) L2 — Dataflow design ( level_2_dataflow_design ) L3 — Low-level optimization tricks ( level_3_low_level_optimization_tricks ) The shared level definitions are in script/design_levels.json ; cross-level reasoning is carried in cross_level_rationale . The capability scorer reports JS_design and JS_impl , each the arithmetic mean of the three level scores (L1 + L2 + L3) / 3 , using the shared 0/25/50/75/100 anchors. Install Use Python 3.10+ on the control host. See SETUP.md for task-table generation, configurable paths and API credentials. Start with .env.example ; keep local keys and run records out of releases. Run python script/audit_public_release.py --history before publishing changes. python -m pip install -r requirements-control.txt Build the GPU runtime either with Docker ( bash docker/build.sh up ) or docker-free on a CUDA-matched host ( python script/setup_envs.py ). Rebuild the packed task tables from the dataset when needed: python script/pack/convert_frontier_sol.py --all --framework triton \ --dataset-root dataset --output tasks/frontier_sol_triton.parquet Start Validate the package offline (no GPU or network): python script/validate_design_levels.py python script/validate_submission.py Start the GPU sandbox, run a task, and score a solution: python script/sandbox/deploy.py local start python script/run_batch.py setup --name run1 --tasks muon_optimizer_step__triton --run python script/bench.py run --task muon_optimizer_step --targets expert,naive,solution --solution-dir < dir > python capability/scorer/score.py --release-root < release > --out < out > See the README.md in each subdirectory for its own contents and commands, and SETUP.md for deployment details.
